nina: FYI JunoRides reported customers seeing unexpected refunds on invoice INV-03-2026. They say a promo credit was applied twice plus a vendor rebate — results in net negative we didn't intend. Can finance take a look?
raj: Link to invoice: https://billing.redwood.com/invoices/INV-03-2026 — pulling ledger now.
amy: Ledger lines: `2026-03-02 CR promo_credit -4,500; 2026-03-02 CR promo_credit -4,500; 2026-03-02 REV vendor_rebate -9,000` looks like promo duplicated.
finance-bot: Automated: created ticket FIN-9932 and refund task R-9920 for INV-03-2026 (status: open).

ops-partner: tagging here — did JunoRides already reconcile vendor rebate on their side? If they've already paid out the rebate we need to net it; if not, we can adjust before settlement.
amy: I approve the manual journal and customer credit memos. Please add note: "duplicate promo applied; manual correction & goodwill credits; partner notified." Go ahead and hold partner payout until cleared. :thumbsup:
raj: Copy. I'll create JE-3094 and update invoice with correction line `CR reversal +4,500` and attach audit note. I'll also start a small batch to notify affected customers via CS with templated note.
nina: Thanks. ops-partner, please confirm whether rebate is cleared on Juno's side. If they confirm paid, we'll offset next settlement and log it under BILL-4803.
